# DynamicCallsToScopeIntrospection

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="info" text="PHP ≥ 7.1" />

Group: [Language level migration](/rules/#language-level-migration) · PhpStorm name: `DynamicCallsToScopeIntrospectionInspection`

Since PHP 7.1, functions that read or write the caller's local scope
(`compact`, `extract`, `func_get_args`, …) refuse to run when invoked
indirectly — through a variable holding their name or as a callback string.
Such calls only produce a warning and do nothing useful.

## Example

```php{4,6,7,10}
<?php
function collect($handler = 'func_get_args')
{
    $grab = $handler();

    $rows = array_map('extract', $input);
    call_user_func_array('\compact', ['a', 'b']);

    $reader = 'mb_parse_str';
    $reader($query, $out);

    $either = $flag ? 'extract' : 'compact';
    $either($row);

    array_filter($items);
    array_filter($items, 'trim');
    compact('grab', 'rows');
}

$top = 'get_defined_vars';
$top();
```

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 4: &#39;func_get_args&#39; reads the caller scope and cannot be invoked indirectly since PHP 7.1.</li>
<li>line 6: &#39;extract&#39; reads the caller scope and cannot be invoked indirectly since PHP 7.1.</li>
<li>line 7: &#39;compact&#39; reads the caller scope and cannot be invoked indirectly since PHP 7.1.</li>
<li>line 10: &#39;mb_parse_str&#39; reads the caller scope and cannot be invoked indirectly since PHP 7.1.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "DynamicCallsToScopeIntrospection": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore DynamicCallsToScopeIntrospection

/**
 * @noinspection DynamicCallsToScopeIntrospectionInspection
 */
```
